title: Cubetown: Echoes of the Maker
core_fantasy: A colorful block world where every obstacle can become a building material and defeated creatures become reusable echoes.
design_pillars: Voxel mining and placement must be immediate, readable, and useful in exploration or combat.
Creature echoes are learned abilities and visible companions, not passive inventory text.
Shrines create an authored adventure spine inside a freely rebuildable world.
Combat, traversal, building, and puzzle solving should combine rather than live in separate modes.
forbidden_crossovers: Do not import Phantom Ages lane-battle controls or age progression.
Do not import Phantom Legends RTS selection or settlement economy.
Do not replace the existing multi-engine Cubetown web source; keep it as compatibility reference.
